lines.zh: 我抱着卷轴，去找下一片林子。
lines.en: I carry my scroll and seek the next woodland.

lines.zh: 地图上的路比脚下清楚。
lines.en: The roads on the map are clearer than the ones underfoot.
I glance at the sky as I walk.
I've charted the butterfly paths here.
I'm heading toward the wood.
The paper roll sways in my hand.
I stop and pace off two steps.
The wind curls my map.
I walk slowly, afraid to misread.
A meadow ahead. Noting it.
I go around the beehive.
I've walked this road several times.
I stand and unroll the map.
I tap a spot with my finger.
A small mark should go here.
I look off into the distance.
The wind lifts a corner of the paper.
I hold it down.
I saw three kinds of butterfly today.
I can't recall that one's color.
I chew the end of my pen.
Someone's coming.
I'll put the map away first.
That'll do.
I crouch down to draw.
The line came out a bit crooked.
Are you here to buy a map?
I have a few new ones.

lines.zh: 我这本地图，画的是蝶的分布。
lines.en: My map charts where the butterflies are.
You must have come through the wetlands.
There's pollen on your shoes.
Did you see any butterflies?
I keep track of the routes here.

lines.zh: 你挡住光，我的图看不清。
lines.en: You block the light and my map blurs.
I don't often talk to people.
Which way are you headed?
The wood over there is thick.
Is that a net in your hand?
That isn't marked on my map.
Careful, don't step on the flowers.
Let me see your soles.
You came from the north.
The color of the soil is wrong for south.
Here, take a look at this.
Ouch, my map.
You hit my shoulder.
I backed off a few paces.
The paper is all crumpled.
I straighten my hat.

lines.zh: 我的制图笔滚进了草丛。
lines.en: My mapping quill rolls into the grass.
I protected my bag.

lines.zh: 别打了，我只是个画图的。
lines.en: Stop. I only draw maps.
My pen fell.
My hand is shaking a little.
What is that object in your hand?
I don't take that.

lines.zh: 你把它收起来吧，我的蜂箱满了。
lines.en: Put it away; my hive box is full.
I only need paper and ink.
Keep that to eat.
I appreciate the thought.
I only trade for goods.

lines.zh: 我画地图，也收蝴蝶标本。
lines.en: I draw maps and collect specimens.
I smell cooked food.
Thanks, leave it there for now.
You knocked my scroll over.
I nearly dropped my map.
Don't crowd me. Paper tears.
You stepped on my map's corner.
I took a step back.
You're covered in dirt.
We collided and the map scattered.
I hurried to gather the papers.
It didn't tear, thankfully.
Watch where you're going.

lines.zh: 我这个人，没什么可说的。
lines.en: There's not much to say about me.
I spend my days with paper.
I can't answer that kind of question.
I'm used to walking alone.
Maps are my company.
Don't laugh at me.
I'm busy here.

lines.zh: 等这张地图画完，再谈别的。
lines.en: Once this map is finished, we'll talk of other things.
It's getting dark.
I have to finish this sheet.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起被风吹落的图页。
lines.en: I bend to pick up a map page the wind tore loose.
I picked it up and blew on it.
It isn't mine.
There are marks of a drawing on it.
It's usable.
Did you drop it?
I put it in my bag.
This is enough for half a map.
Don't step, don't step.
Good thing it didn't get wet.

lines.zh: 我摊开手里的图，标下这一笔。
lines.en: I unfold my map and mark this spot.
I should pace out that stretch first.
There's something on this road.
I'll note it down.
The wind shifted. The butterflies will go that way.
I must make it before sunset.
Is there a path through that wood?
The map shows it cut off.
I'll have to walk over and see.
Don't block the way ahead.

lines.zh: 这条路通向哪，我得看看。
lines.en: I need to see where this road leads.
Your footprints are fresh.
I can draw them.
I hear water nearby.
The grass is pressed. Someone passed.
I should add that trail.
I'm studying that slope.
There should be water beyond it.
I compare it with the map.
It's a little off.
Twenty more steps.

lines.zh: 这里的花开得比图上晚。
lines.en: The flowers bloom later than the map shows.
I added a line.
Has this stream changed course?
The mud is fresh.
Then it has changed course.
I cross out the old one.
That's right now.
I'll look a little farther.
The figure ahead has vanished.
I've noted the spot.
I don't know this area well.
Must go slowly.
Easy. It'll get drawn.
I don't fight.
I only have a pen.
Don't push. The paper will tear.
I raised the map to block.
Maps are the only thing I tally.
Don't hit my maps.
This one took three days.
I dodged aside.
You shoved me into a tree.
I shield my bag and back away.
I can only block, not strike back.
Why would you hit people?
I shouldn't have taken this road.
Is anyone there?

lines.zh: 这一带的蝶道，都在我的图上。
lines.en: Every butterfly path here is on my map.
No one here will help me.

lines.zh: 我在这条路上走了很久。
lines.en: I've walked this road a long while.

lines.zh: 你看见我手里的图了吗？
lines.en: See the map in my hand?
Does anyone live here?
I want to chart this area.
There's pollen in the wind.
A butterfly just flew by.
I stopped to write it down.
No one has charted this stretch.
I uncap my pen.
Are you from around here?
Do you know the way?
I've wandered rather far.
I recognize this tree.
Then I'm not lost.
I unrolled the map to compare.
The sun's position matches too.
I need somewhere to sit.
Go on with your business.

lines.zh: 火烧到纸角，一下就没了。
lines.en: Fire caught the paper corner and it was gone.

lines.zh: 我滑下土坡，卷轴散了一地。
lines.en: I slide down the slope, scrolls scattering.

lines.zh: 河水没到胸口，我的图纸湿了。
lines.en: The river reaches my chest and soaks my maps.
The blast blew all my maps away.
An arrow grazed my arm.
The light flashed and my eyes blurred.
Walking this long, I've grown hungry.

lines.zh: 雷声就在头顶，我蹲了下来。
lines.en: Thunder right overhead. I crouched down.
There's nothing below here.
